title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Analista de Governança de Dados
description:

  • Ensino superior completo. Área de formação: Ciências da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, e/ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos

  • Papéis e responsabilidades (Data Owner, Data Steward, Data Custodian, Comitês de Dados, estruturas de decisão)
  • Qualidade de Dados (Dimensões de qualidade, métricas, monitoramento e tratamentos).
  • Fontes de dados e interfaces (Sistemas de origem, integrações/ APIs e fluxos de dados, integridade e consistência dos dados).

  • Políticas, normas e procedimentos (Políticas de dados, padrões e diretrizes corporativas).
  • Retenção, descarte e ciclo de vida dos dados (Regras de retenção, descarte seguro e conformidade regulatória).

Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão crítica.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar informações complexas de forma objetiva.
  • Postura consultiva e senso de priorização de riscos.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java 11+ : Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento backend utilizando Java 11 ou superior.

Spring Boot : Domínio do framework Spring Boot para construção de aplicações e serviços.

AWS (API Gateway, VPC Link, NLB, ECS) : Vivência com arquitetura e operação de serviços na AWS, incluindo API Gateway, VPC Link, Network Load Balancer e ECS.

APIs REST (desenvolvimento e consumo) : Capacidade de desenvolver APIs REST e integrar sistemas por meio do consumo de APIs REST de terceiros.

Testes (unitários e performance) : Prática em testes unitários com JUnit/Mockito e execução/análise de testes de performance.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Permitting

  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.

Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.

  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.

  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, building channel structures, managing key partners, driving sell-in and sell-out performance, and ensuring strong brand and product positioning at retail level. Distributor & Retail Management

- Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, margins, assortments, and commercial terms.

- Develop joint business plans with distributors and key retail partners.

- Ensure strong in-store execution including assortment, merchandising, promotions, and training.

Sales Execution & Performance Management

- Own regional sales targets including revenue, volume, and product mix.

- Track KPIs such as sell-in, sell-out, ASP, and inventory turns.

- Work closely with marketing and GTM teams to adapt tools and messaging locally.


Cross-Functional Coordination

- Act as the LATAM point of contact for supply chain, marketing, after-sales, and finance teams.

Preferred Backgrounds

Experience & Qualifications Required

- 7–12+ years of sales experience in Latin America with regional responsibility.

- Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; professional working level of English.

Strong Plus

- Consistent sell-in growth supported by improving sell-out performance.

- Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.

description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media ( Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Java backend development experience
  • Solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems thinking)
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs or backend services
  • Comfort working with relational databases
  • Familiarity with HTTP, authentication, and web architecture


Nice to Have

  • PostgreSQL
  • Python development experience
  • Experience with Apache Tomcat or Java Servlets
  • Frontend exposure (TypeScript, Vue, or similar)
  • CI/CD pipeline experience


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Gerente de Produto Sr.
description:
Gerente de Produto Sr.

Home Office | PJ


Você será responsável pela visão de produto das ferramentas internas que gestores de portfólio, analistas quantitativos e traders utilizam diariamente. Não se trata de gestão de produtos para o consumidor final — seus usuários gerenciam bilhões e não têm paciência para softwares que os atrasem.

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"

\"Um ótimo gestor de portfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\"


\" Conhecimento da área financeira é imprescindível — não negociável

- Fluxo de trabalho de investimento: Geração de ideias → pesquisa → construção de portfólio → execução → monitoramento → relatórios

- Gestão de portfólio: Ações long/short, multiestratégia, estruturas de alocação, lógica de rebalanceamento, gestão de drawdown

- Risco e conformidade: Limites de posição, risco de concentração, relatórios regulatórios (13F, AIFMD), padrões de relatórios para investidores

- Operações de negociação: Sistemas OMS/EMS, fundamentos do protocolo FIX, verificações de conformidade pré-negociação, alocação de negociações

- Atribuição de desempenho: Atribuição Brinson, decomposição de fatores, relatórios de retorno relativo ao benchmark versus retorno absoluto

- Relações com investidores: Relatórios para LPs, fluxos de trabalho DDQ, fundamentos de contabilidade de fundos, processos de chamada de capital/distribuição


Habilidades

- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de produtos — com pelo menos 3 anos em serviços financeiros, gestão de ativos ou fintech atendendo clientes institucionais

- Você já desenvolveu produtos para investidores profissionais, traders ou gestores de portfólio — não para o varejo

- Capacidade de ler e discutir um relatório de atribuição de fatores Análise detalhada de lucros e perdas ou resumo da exposição ao risco sem glossário

- Experiência com fornecedores de OMS/EMS (Charles River, Advent, Eze ou equivalentes)

- Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar roteiros em ambientes altamente regulamentados e sujeitos a auditorias

- Forte intuição para dados — você consegue escrever SQL e consultar um modelo de dados de forma independente

- MBA ou CFA são um diferencial; experiência comprovada na área é mais importante

Estamos em busca de Sourcer Júnior/Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação na AI/R Company, empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.



Você será responsável por:


  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.



O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação ( Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência em desenvolvimento de scripts automatizados para testes funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Metodologias: Conhecimento em BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) e TDD (Test-Driven Development).
  • Ferramentas de Automação: Cypress — Para testes end-to-end em aplicações web. Selenium — Automação de testes em navegadores. Appium — Testes de automação em dispositivos móveis. Java — Linguagem principal para desenvolvimento dos testes automatizados.
  • Ferramentas de Teste de API: Postman — Testes de APIs REST. SOAPUI — Testes em serviços web SOAP.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência em práticas Shift Left Testing, antecipando a validação para as etapas iniciais do ciclo de desenvolvimento. Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD para integração contínua dos testes.
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Project Manager (experience w/ EDI)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a Senior IT Project Manager with a minimum of 8 years of experience in managing complex IT projects.
  • Proven expertise in leading global E-Invoicing programs, EDI, or tax-driven IT solutions, ensuring legal compliance across multiple countries and SAP landscapes (S/4HANA and ECC).
  • Experience in driving global XSTORE upgrade projects (preferably V25), enabling standardized retail setups.
  • Strong knowledge of IT project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid), IT change and release management, and process management in regulated environments.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS PowerPoint, Teams, and preferably Clarity PPM.
  • Solid experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, particularly in billing and interface management.
  • Ability to translate legal and fiscal requirements into IT solutions.
  • Proven experience in coordinating external service providers and system integrators.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, rhetoric, and presentation skills.
  • PMP or comparable project management certification is highly desirable.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Location: Portugal or abroad (Remote from Portugal or abroad options available).
  • Eligibility: Portuguese national, foreign national with existing permission, or foreign national in visa process.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote;


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais:

title: Data Annotator
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency (written and verbal).
  • Native resident of Japan
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.

title: Especialista de Arquitetura e Implantação | Expansão
description:
Descrição da vaga

No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.


Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.


Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L. Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis. É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável.
  • Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética.
  • Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves.
  • Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping (Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc. ), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.
  • Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo.
  • Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas.
  • Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil.
  • Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas.
  • Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante.
  • Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança.
  • Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil \"dono do negócio\", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
  • Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de AutoCad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX).
  • Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens.


Informações adicionais


NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história.

• Seguro de vida

• Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass

• Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental


Dia a dia e qualidade de vida


• Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash

• Vale transporte

• Day off de aniversário

• Extensão de licença maternidade

• Extensão de licença paternidade

• Descontos nas marcas do grupo


Desenvolvimento e crescimento


• Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento

Reconhecimento

title: Senior Technical Analyst

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Linux Server Manager
description:
Cargo: Linux Server Manager

Local de atuação: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Fluente

Contrato : 1 ano, podendo prorrogar.


Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.

Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).

  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
