  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.

description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Analista de Application Security (AppSec) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a segurança das aplicações desde o desenvolvimento até a produção, atuando de forma próxima aos times de engenharia para prevenir vulnerabilidades e fortalecer a cultura de segurança dentro dos projetos.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Segurança em IA: Atuar diretamente com squads de Inteligência Artificial, garantindo a segurança e resiliência de agentes autônomos.
  • Segurança Multicloud: Operar o hardening de ambientes (IAM, Redes, Gestão de Segredos) em AWS, Azure, GCP e OCI.
  • Cultura DevSecOps: Implementar e evoluir stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets) no GitLab CI/CD, garantindo automação total.
  • Parceria com Squads: Apoiar desenvolvedores na triagem, priorização e correção de vulnerabilidades via code review e práticas de Secure SDLC.
  • Proposição Técnica: Definir padrões de segurança para APIs (REST/GraphQL) e arquiteturas modernas, focando em soluções e não apenas em apontar problemas.
  • Disseminação de Conhecimento: Promover treinamentos e workshops para elevar a barra de segurança dos times de engenharia.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Perfil Híbrido: Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de software e transição consolidada para Application Security (AppSec).
  • Automação: Capacidade de desenvolver scripts (Python ou Bash) para automação de tarefas de segurança e resposta a incidentes.
  • GitLab: Experiência prática em configurar pipelines de CI/CD integrando ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk ou SonarQube.
  • Fundamentos de Cyber: Sólidos conhecimentos em autenticação, autorização (RBAC/IAM), WAF, EDR e OWASP Top 10.
  • Gestão de Segredos: Familiaridade com ferramentas de Vault (Hashicorp, AWS, Azure, GCP ou OCI).
  • Comunicação Proativa: Habilidade para transitar entre discussões técnicas de código e apresentações de métricas/soluções (powerpoint) para stakeholders.
  • Cloud: Conhecimentos de desenvolvimento em alguma das 4 clouds (AWS, GCP, OCI e Azure)


Diferenciais:

  • Domínio Técnico: Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise (Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk, SonarQube ou similares).
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Familiaridade com segurança em containers e ferramentas como Checkov ou Prowler.
  • Certificações: Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) ou segurança (Security+, CEH, CSSLP).
  • Modelagem de Ameaças: Experiência prática com Threat Modeling.
  • Segurança Ofensiva: Conhecimentos em PenTest, Redes e ferramentas como OWASP ZAP ou Burp Suite.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.

  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.

  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

About Us

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

Vaga remota

title: Coordenador(a) de Marca e Eventos
description:
Sobre a Bro

A Bro é uma marca carioca de activewear premium. Vestimos a mulher que treina todo dia e leva o estilo de vida ativo — dentro e fora da academia. Estamos crescendo rápido, com lojas físicas, drops sazonais e uma comunidade engajada que vive o nicho de verdade.


Sobre a vaga

Procuramos uma pessoa que faça as coisas acontecerem. Você vai ser a ponte entre a direção criativa, os fornecedores, os parceiros e os eventos da marca. É um papel operacional, hands-on, de coordenação e produção — não é vaga de estrategista, é vaga de quem resolve.

Se você é do nicho fitness, treina, conhece as academias, os atletas, os eventos do Rio e o comportamento dessa galera (tanto no Instagram quanto na musculação às 6h da manhã), você sai na frente.


O que você vai fazer
  • Coordenar eventos da marca — desde ativações em loja, lançamentos de coleção, presença em eventos do nicho (campeonatos, expos, parcerias com academias) até eventos próprios da Bro.
  • Produzir campanhas de foto e vídeo — coordenação de produção (não criação): cronograma, locação, casting, fornecedores, logística no set, alinhamento com a direção criativa.
  • Negociar com fornecedores — gráficas, brindes, adesivos, materiais de PDV pras lojas, deslocamentos, locações, equipes de apoio.
  • Prospectar e negociar parcerias — atletas, academias, influenciadores do nicho, marcas parceiras, eventos terceiros.
  • Gerenciar materiais de loja e evento — manter as lojas e ativações sempre abastecidas com materiais que reforcem a identidade da marca.


Requisitos (must-have)
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro — você vai estar na rua, em loja, em set, em evento.
  • 3+ anos de experiência em coordenação de marketing, brand, eventos ou produção (agência, marca ou produtora).
  • Comunicação impecável — oral e escrita. Você vai falar com fornecedor, atleta, parceiro, equipe interna e cliente final. Quem se comunica mal trava o fluxo.
  • Mão na massa — você não terceiriza, você executa. Sabe pedir orçamento, comparar, negociar e fechar.
  • Organização e gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos — vai rodar evento, campanha e parceria ao mesmo tempo.
  • Entendimento de comportamento on/offline do nicho fitness — você sabe como esse público consome conteúdo, o que engaja, o que soa falso, e como o nicho se comporta dentro e fora da academia.


Diferenciais (nice-to-have)
  • Faz parte do nicho fitness — treina, frequenta academia, conhece a cena carioca de musculação/crossfit/funcional.
  • Network ativo com atletas, influenciadores ou academias do Rio.
  • Experiência prévia com marca de moda, lifestyle ou esportiva.
  • Vivência em produção de conteúdo (foto/vídeo) no set.
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de gestão de projeto (Trello, Drive).


Soft skills que importam aqui
  • Proatividade real — não espera briefing pra agir.
  • Resiliência — evento e produção dão errado o tempo todo. Quem trava no primeiro problema, não serve.
  • Senso estético — não precisa ser designer, mas tem que reconhecer o que é Bro e o que não é.
  • Negociação — você vai brigar por preço, prazo e condição toda semana.
  • Ownership — o que você toca, é seu até entregar.


O que oferecemos
  • Salário compatível com o mercado + benefícios (a combinar)
  • Modelo híbrido com base no Rio
  • Ambiente de marca em crescimento, com autonomia real
  • Desconto em produtos Bro
  • (adicionar: VR/VT/plano de saúde/bônus se aplicável)


Como se candidatar

Envie currículo + um parágrafo curto contando por que você é do nicho e um evento ou campanha que você coordenou (com link ou foto, se possível) pra: 

Não queremos carta de apresentação genérica — queremos saber se você é da cena.

title: Digital Marketing Ad Strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.

You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.


Requirements

  • In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
  • Detail oriented



Key Responsibilities


Account Audits & Diagnostics

 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.

 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers

 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:

 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking

 • Pixel or tag misfires

 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies

 • Budget pacing and delivery issues

 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization

 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations


 Optimization & Performance Management

• Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives

 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate

 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities

 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages

 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)


 Strategy & Execution

 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies

 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys

 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices


 Tracking, Data & Reporting

 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking

 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity

 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities

 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps


 Process & Quality Control

• Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation

 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists

 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices

 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends


Additional Tasks

 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.

 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.


Language Requirements

 • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Salary

$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start

Benefits after 6 months


Hiring Process:

Initial Interview with small knowledge test

Second interview with Ads team

Possible follow up questions / test

  • Final meet and greet meeting

Atribuições da função: -Elaborar e monitorar o projeto que visa reposicionar a Aprendizagem Profissional do Senac,assegurando alinhamento às diretrizes institucionais, legislação vigente e necessidades do mercado de trabalho.

-Orientar e acompanhar a realização dos programas de aprendizagem profissional executados pelos Departamentos Regionais, visando assegurar aderência pedagógica, qualidade técnica e conformidade normativa.

-Propor melhorias para a execução dos programas de aprendizagem do Senac, em nível nacional para o aperfeiçoamento contínuo, com base em análises comparativas, evidências pedagógicas, indicadores de desempenho, demandas do mundo do trabalho, entre outros.

-Prestar assessoramento técnico aos Departamentos Regionais no que se refere ao desenvolvimento dos programas de aprendizagem do Senac, com foco em adequação e execução do programa, metodologias e processos educacionais.

-Intermediar, junto aos Departamentos Regionais, o atendimento às demandas das empresas parceiras dos programas de aprendizagem, subsidiando solução de necessidades operacionais, pedagógicas e administrativo-regulatórias da aprendizagem.

-Analisar, diagnosticar e apresentar soluções técnico-administrativas relativas aos Programas de Aprendizagem Profissional do Senac, por meio de dados, indicadores, relatórios, conformidade, efetividade pedagógica, propondo recomendações técnico-administrativas para aprimoramento do programa em escala nacional.

-Elaborar documentos técnicos e analíticos relativos às demandas da Aprendizagem Profissional, abrangendo avaliações de impacto, comparativos entre regionais e recomendações estratégicas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão.

-Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Conceitos e fundamentos da educação profissional e tecnológica; normativas que regulamentam a Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei nº 10.097/2000; Decreto 9.579/2018; Portaria MTE 3.872/2023; dentre outras); informações técnico/operacionais da Aprendizagem Profissional; Catálogo Nacional da Aprendizagem (CONAP) e Cadastro Nacional da Aprendizagem Profissional (CNAP); redação de textos técnicos educacionais; Pacote Office em nível intermediário; ferramentas de apresentação (Canva, PowerPoint, Prezi entre outros).

title: Supervisor Sell Out
description:
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO


O Sales Supervisor é responsável por liderar a performance comercial, excelência operacional e execução da marca em todas as lojas Sephora sob sua responsabilidade.

Essa posição é dona do negócio regional, com forte foco em atingimento de metas, sell-out, acompanhamento de estoque, relacionamento, treinamento e execução impecável em loja. Atua conectando as prioridades comerciais da marca à realidade do ponto de venda, assegurando que todos os pontos de contato com o cliente reflitam os padrões de excelência da marca.

Responsável por garantir que a equipe de vendas esteja altamente treinada, engajada e com domínio sobre os produtos, ações em loja e abordagens de venda.


Reporte direto: Sales & Education Manager

Localização: Rio de Janeiro (RJ) – Brasil

Escala de trabalho: Segunda a sexta

Disponibilidade para viagens: Aproximadamente 40% do tempo


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


ESTRATÉGIA COMERCIAL

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais para impulsionar crescimento de sell-out, produtividade e visibilidade da marca nas lojas.
  • Ser responsável pela performance regional de vendas, metas e indicadores, com forte senso de dono do negócio.
  • Analisar indicadores de performance (sell-out, ranking, produtividade e atingimento de metas) para definir prioridades estratégicas de atuação em campo.
  • Identificar oportunidades em cada loja para maximizar resultados comerciais e exposição da marca.


VENDAS & RESULTADOS

  • Apoiar a definição de metas mensais de vendas, objetivos de ativações e eventos por loja.
  • Acompanhar semanalmente a performance de vendas, níveis de estoque, tendências de mercado e movimentações da concorrência.
  • Impulsionar conversão, produtividade e priorização da marca no chão de loja.
  • Monitorar o atingimento de metas das lojas da região e atuar proativamente nas correções de rota necessárias.
  • Utilizar dados para direcionar decisões comerciais e transformá-los em ações executáveis em campo.


EXCELÊNCIA OPERACIONAL

  • Supervisionar as operações diárias de todas as lojas sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Atuar em parceria com Supply Chain no acompanhamento semanal de estoque, reposições e reduções de rupturas.
  • Garantir o uso correto de ferramentas, testers, brindes e materiais de apoio em loja.
  • Manter alto nível de excelência operacional, organização e consistência de execução em toda a região.
  • Identificar e endereçar oportunidades no ponto de venda que destaquem e favoreçam a marca.


VISUAL MERCHANDISING & EXECUÇÃO

  • Garantir execução impecável do Visual Merchandising seguindo os guidelines da marca.
  • Otimizar posicionamento de produtos, layouts e visibilidades para apoiar a performance de sell-out.
  • Assegurar que gondolas, testers, ferramentas e materiais estejam dentro dos padrões de excelência da marca.
  • Apoiar a execução de lançamentos, ativações e atualizações de espaços.


TEAM DEVELOPMENT

  • Liderar, treinar e inspirar os BCs e influenciar as equipes de loja da Sephora.
  • Conduzir gestão próxima, profissional e humanizada, direcionamentos claros e feedback contínuo.
  • Recrutar e desenvolver equipes de campo.
  • Construir e gerenciar agendas de escalas e planos de cobertura mensais.
  • Fomentar engajamento, responsabilidade e senso de pertencimento à marca.
  • Ser referência em postura profissional, apresentação e comunicação.
  • Fomentar a colaboração entre os BCs, lideranças de lojas e parceiros de loja.



HABILIDADES & COMPETÊNCIAS

  • Forte perfil de liderança, com atuação prática em campo e foco no desenvolvimento de pessoas
  • Perfil comercial, orientado a resultados e com alto senso de responsabilidade pelo negócio
  • Alta capacidade relacional e diplomática, com habilidade para influenciar, negociar e resolver conflitos
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com aplicação prática de dados na tomada de decisão
  • Excelente habilidade de treinamento, didática e comunicação
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas frentes simultaneamente
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes de vendas altamente dinâmicos e competitivos
  • Postura proativa, resiliente e orientada a resultados




QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência prática em vendas e treinamento
  • Experiência prévia no varejo de beleza (desejável)
  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de equipes de venda em loja
  • Vivência sólida em chão de loja, com forte entendimento operacional
  • Conhecimento de Excel para análise de sell-out e acompanhamento de resultados
  • Prática em PowerPoint para elaboração de apresentações
  • Conhecimento técnico como maquiador é um diferencial
  • Proficiência em inglês é um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)



Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso? Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa.



No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Estratégia e arquitetura de jornada: criar e implementar jornadas baseadas em dados unificados, mapeando processos de negócio para identificar gargalos e propor intervenções estratégicas que destravem valor.
  • Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas.
  • Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS.
  • Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento.
  • Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão.
  • Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente.
  • Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos; Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas.
  • Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos.


Requisitos



  • Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de estratégias de comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
  • Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
  • Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Estratégia CDP & DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos

title: Operations Assistant – Rezeption & Buchhaltung
description:
Über Digital Studio Rio


Digital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können.



Deine Mission


Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung .

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden.


Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen.

  • Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend

  • Bearbeitung von Rückerstattungen , Gutschriften und ähnlichen Zahlungsvorgängen
  • Abstimmung zwischen Rezeption / Gästeservice und Buchhaltung
  • Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten bei Zahlungen, Buchungen oder Abrechnungen
  • Pflege und strukturierte Dokumentation von Abläufen, Informationen und internen Standards
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um Buchungen und Gästeprozesse
  • Bei Bedarf Backup-Unterstützung für die Rezeption , z. B. bei Gästefragen oder operativen Engpässen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem bestehenden Team in Rio



Das bringst du mit


  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B1-Niveau , schriftlich und mündlich
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Gutes Verständnis für administrative und backendseitige Abläufe
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Systemen und standardisierten Prozessen
  • Fähigkeit, sauber, konzentriert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten
  • Bereitschaft, sich in neue Systeme und Abläufe einzuarbeiten
  • Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation



Große Vorteile für diese Rolle


  • Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, vorbereitender Buchhaltung oder Abrechnung
  • Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen operativem Betrieb und Finance/Buchhaltung
  • Erfahrung mit Rückerstattungen, Zahlungsabgleichen oder Buchungskontrolle
  • Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Rezeption, Reservierung oder Gästeservice
  • Kenntnisse in DATEV sind ideal, aber keine Voraussetzung
  • Wichtig ist vor allem die Bereitschaft, sich strukturiert einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen



Rahmenbedingungen


  • Remote-Position in Brasilien
  • Idealerweise in Rio de Janeiro
  • Vollzeit, Teilzeit nach Absprache möglich
  • Start: so bald wie möglich



Bewerbung


Bitte bewirb dich direkt über mit:


  • deinem Lebenslauf auf Deutsch
  • einem kurzen Satz, warum du gut zu dieser Rolle passt


Bitte beantworte außerdem auf Deutsch diese 3 Fragen:


  • Wo wohnst du aktuell?
  • Wann kannst du anfangen?
  • Ein Gast schreibt:
  • „Wir kommen heute später an. Können wir trotzdem einchecken?“
  • Was antwortest du?

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our \"One World\" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.


In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Role Overview

KPIT is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer (Remote) to architect, develop, and deliver end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the entire AI lifecycle—from designing scalable data pipelines to deploying production-grade AI agents capable of complex, multi-step reasoning. This role is ideal for an engineer who excels at bridging the gap between experimental data science and robust, scalable MLOps.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from initial problem definition and data acquisition to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Spark on Azure Databricks.
  • Model Development & Feature Engineering: Perform advanced feature engineering, data preparation, and sophisticated model development for diverse business use cases.
  • Agentic AI & GenAI: Develop and deploy AI agents and workflows utilizing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and Generative AI frameworks.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement and manage MLflow for experiment tracking; monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability in production environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert, mentoring junior team members and driving engineering best practices.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Programming & Data: Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Big Data & Cloud: Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Apache Spark, and Azure Databricks.
  • Machine Learning: Deep understanding of ML workflows, model evaluation techniques, and statistical modeling.
  • MLOps: Practical experience with MLflow and fundamental MLOps principles (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and monitoring).
  • Generative AI: Proven exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen).
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Production Experience: A proven track record of deploying and maintaining ML/AI models in a production environment.
  • Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience working within cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.


About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. We deliver end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers worldwide, shaping the future of mobility.

Performance Tuning: Perform advanced performance tuning at both Oracle database level (SQL tuning, indexing) and PeopleSoft application level (App Server/Batch tuning).

Data Integrity & Security: Implement robust backup and recovery processes using Oracle RMAN; manage PeopleSoft security (roles, permission lists, SSO).

Automation: Develop automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for environment refreshes, backups, and monitoring.

Disaster Recovery: Design and test Disaster Recovery (DR) plans using Oracle Data Guard or similar tools.

Mentorship: Provide leadership and guidance to junior DBAs; collaborate with PeopleSoft Developers and Functional Analysts.

PeopleTools:Extensive experience with PeopleTools 8.5x – 8.6x (Application Designer, Data Mover, Change Assistant) Database:Mastery of Oracle 19c/21c, SQL, PL/SQL, RMAN.Experience with Exadata or OCI is a plus Middleware:Deep knowledge of Oracle WebLogic, Tuxedo, Integration Broker (IB) Operating Systems:Expert-level proficiency in Linux/Unix (OEL, RedHat) and shell scripting Tools:Hands-on experience with PeopleTools or Stat for version control and migrations

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?

  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Seja diferente, seja independente
