About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands.


Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Content & channels

  • Produce and distribute content across priority channels (, email, blog and future channels)
  • Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats
  • Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing


2.Brand consistency & messaging

  • Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints
  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets
  • Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives


4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Strong writing and content creation skills
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post
  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools
  • Experience in technical, engineering or architecture-related industries


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Gerente de Projetos Estratégicos AI
description:
Descrição da vaga

No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.


Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.


Sua missão é garantir que a adoção de AI na empresa aconteça de forma estruturada, escalável e orientada a impacto, conectando as iniciativas descentralizadas das áreas com a estratégia global e promovendo consistência na forma como AI é aplicada no negócio.


Esse papel é responsável por transformar múltiplas iniciativas isoladas em um ecossistema coordenado de alto valor, impulsionando adoção, direcionamento estratégico e geração de resultados mensuráveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Estruturar e consolidar um plano robusto de iniciativas de AI junto às diretorias da empresa, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia global.
  • Atuar como ponto central de orquestração das iniciativas de AI, trazendo visibilidade, consistência e direcionamento.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Tech Lead na definição de diretrizes e padrões de AI, equilibrando estratégia, governança e viabilidade prática.
  • Influenciar lideranças e áreas de negócio na priorização de iniciativas com maior potencial de impacto.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos projetos estratégicos, garantindo medição de resultado e geração de valor real.
  • Identificar e estimular a formação de heavy users de AI nas áreas, aumentando a capilaridade e autonomia das iniciativas.
  • Atuar como facilitador para destravar iniciativas, conectando áreas, parceiros e recursos quando necessário.
  • Gerar uma visão consolidada para a liderança executiva, trazendo insights, aprendizados e direcionamentos estratégicos.
  • Apoiar decisões de ajuste de rota em iniciativas de AI, em conjunto com liderança e stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida em estruturação e gestão de iniciativas estratégicas, idealmente em contextos de consultoria, transformação ou tecnologia.
  • Forte capacidade de priorização baseada em impacto e viabilidade.
  • Experiência em ambientes com múltiplos stakeholders e alta complexidade organizacional.
  • Entendimento prático de como soluções de tecnologia/AI geram valor.
  • Capacidade de definir e acompanhar métricas de impacto e adoção.
  • Alta capacidade de influência e articulação com diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Pensamento estruturado e visão sistêmica.
  • Comunicação executiva clara e objetiva.
  • Perfil analítico com forte orientação a resultado.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Habilidade de navegar em ambientes ambíguos e em construção.

title: Gerente de Soluções Trilingue
description:

title: Talent Matcher (Recruiter) - 75290
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Supervisor de SMS
description:
SUPERVISOR DE SMS


Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor (a) de SMS para apoiar as atividades de um projeto EPC na área de gás natural, localizado em São Paulo. O(a) profissional será responsável por acompanhar as etapas de construção, montagem e comissionamento, assegurando o atendimento aos requisitos legais e a aplicação das práticas corporativas de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente, contribuindo diretamente para o nosso compromisso de Zero Acidentes e Respeito ao Meio Ambiente. A função requer disponibilidade para presença periódica no local do projeto, com viagens frequentes a São Paulo conforme as demandas operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

  • Implementar e garantir a manutenção dos requisitos legais aplicáveis à área de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente (SSMA);
  • Apoiar os gestores das demais áreas na aplicação das práticas de SMS, assegurando conformidade com padrões corporativos, procedimentos e interfaces estabelecidas;
  • Assegurar a implementação, revisão e atualização de procedimentos, manuais e registros de SSMA;
  • Conduzir análises e investigações de acidentes e incidentes, garantindo o registro adequado, o acompanhamento e a efetiva implementação das ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Planejar e garantir a realização de inspeções e auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Implementar e acompanhar programas de prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, monitorando indicadores, resultados e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Acompanhar a implantação do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, incluindo o gerenciamento de licenças e condicionantes, bem como a análise e aprovação de relatórios técnicos;
  • Participar da elaboração, revisão e implementação das políticas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Planejar, coordenar e implementar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos da área de SMS;
  • Garantir a gestão em campo dos processos de gerenciamento de resíduos, produtos químicos e demais requisitos ambientais aplicáveis;
  • Reportar diretamente à Coordenação Geral de SMS.


Requisitos

  • Formação: Graduação em Engenharia com Pós-Graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho ;
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência em SMS no setor de óleo e gás (construção, operação e manutenção);
  • Conhecimentos: Legislação e normas aplicáveis -NR-35, NR-33, NR-20, NR-18, NR-12, Instruções Técnicas e demais requisitos legais;
  • Disponibilidade: Para acompanhar presencialmente a execução de um projeto EPC em São Paulo, com visitas frequentes conforme a necessidade;
  • Base preferencial no Rio de Janeiro, com viagens frequentes a São Paulo.


Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação e refeição;
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica 100% custeado pela empresa extensivo a dependentes;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale Transporte.


Sobre a Geogas

A Geogas é uma empresa 100% brasileira, criada com o propósito de oferecer soluções inovadoras e seguras para o mercado de gás natural, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional e para a descarbonização do setor, desde a implantação de projetos até a operação e manutenção de ativos.


Nossas Soluções em Gás Natural

  • EPC, instalação e O&M de UPGN, gasodutos e sistemas de medição;
  • EPC, aluguel, instalação e O&M de estações de compressão de gás natural;
  • Compressão para Cabeça de Poço;
  • Equipamentos para tratamento e processamento de gás natural;
  • Motocompressores para estocagem de gás e estações de compressão;
  • Motogeradores a gás para alimentação de data centers;
  • Soluções em Biometano, GNL e Regaseificação.


Nossas Soluções em Descarbonização

  • Serviços de compressão portátil para captura e transferência de gás, minimizando purgas e emissões de metano;
  • Compressores para injeção de CO₂;
  • Soluções em Biometano e Bio-LNG.


Nossos Valores

  • Respeito às pessoas e ao meio ambiente;
  • Transparência e integridade nas relações;
  • Atitude de dono;
  • Inovação e entrega de soluções tecnológicas;
  • Capacitação e aprendizado contínuo;
  • Satisfação dos clientes internos e externos;
  • Comprometimento com resultados operacionais e econômicos.

title: Innovation & Strategy Engineer
description:
Sensor Tower is seeking an Innovation & Strategy Engineer to join our I&S team as it continues to grow and deliver cutting-edge market intelligence solutions to our most valued clients. Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Strategy, this role offers a unique opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in data analytics and consulting. You will collaborate directly with customers and engineers to develop and implement innovative market data solutions, contributing to Sensor Tower's leadership in the industry.


Please note: This is an individual contributor role with no management responsibilities.

Employment: Full-time under a B2B contract.


What the Innovation & Strategy will do:


  • Entrepreneurial Innovation & Data Utilization: Leverage your hands-on experience with data to explore and define innovative solutions, developing new use-cases for data assets that scale to create strategic opportunities
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Employ strong analytical and storytelling skills to transform complex data into compelling narratives that communicate insights and persuade stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and customers to develop and implement comprehensive solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and integration
  • Client Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including Fortune 500 companies, ensuring their success through strategic insights and tailored solutions.
  • Sales & Strategic Support: Partner with the Sales Team to support business development efforts, articulating the strategic impact of our solutions and aiding in the proposal process.


Experience and skills that the candidate can bring:


  • Data Proficiency: Proven ability to manage and analyze large datasets independently, developing innovative solutions and actionable insights. Expertise in data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated track record of identifying, scaling, and creating new data use-cases that drive significant business value. An entrepreneurial approach to developing strategic opportunities.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Ability to transform complex data into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration with sales, engineering, and client teams to implement integrated solutions.
  • Client Relations: Proven experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 companies, focusing on client success and satisfaction.


Fraud warning: It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as , Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob.


At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com or text.

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Content Creator
description:
Localização:  Remoto

Tipo:  Freelance / Contrato

Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)

Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana


Sobre o Pure

O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.

Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.


Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (TikTok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.


O que você vai fazer
  • Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc.)
  • Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
  • Direcionar pessoas para o app
  • Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
  • Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
  • Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais


O que buscamos
  • Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
  • Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
  • Familiaridade com tendências do TikTok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
  • Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
  • Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
  • Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos


Estrutura de pagamento
  • Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
  • Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
  • Bônus por registros
  • Pagamentos realizados semanalmente
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
  • Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
  • Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
  • Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva

    • Como se candidatar

    Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

    Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.

    Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.

    As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:

Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.

O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.

  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Sourcer Júnior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratações LATAM da AI/R Company. Empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte do grupo.

Você irá apoiar o mapeamento de mercado, a identificação de talentos e a construção de pipelines, atuando em parceria com recrutadores para contribuir com processos mais assertivos e uma boa experiência para os candidatos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias de sourcing com apoio do time;
  • Criar e manter listas e pipelines de talentos organizados;
  • Realizar primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar e manter informações em ferramentas como ATS e ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com recrutadores e lideranças para entender perfis e prioridades;
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios simples de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir com ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com recrutamento, sourcing ou pesquisa de talentos;
  • Experiência trabalhando com SLA curto de entrega de candidatos;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e pelo mercado de talentos tech;
  • Familiaridade com ou outras plataformas de busca de perfis;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e curiosidade por desafios;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento, podendo ser compartilhados com clientes e empresas do Grupo CompassUol envolvidas nos projetos.

title: Executivo de vendas (Estaleiros e Armadores)
description:
O Executivo de Vendas interagirá diretamente com estaleiros, armadores e equipes técnicas, apresentando propostas baseadas em valor e garantindo que as soluções da Empresa estejam bem posicionadas para atender às necessidades dos clientes e aos requisitos dos projetos.



Principais responsabilidades:

Representação de produtos e soluções

  • Desenvolver um profundo conhecimento dos produtos dos fornecedores e suas aplicações em projetos de construção naval, reparo e conversão.
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e comerciais personalizadas para atender às necessidades de estaleiros e armadores.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tecnologias, certificações e padrões da indústria dos fornecedores.


Desenvolvimento de Negócios

  • Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios com estaleiros, armadores e outras partes interessadas nos mercados marítimo e offshore.
  • Construir e gerenciar um pipeline de clientes potenciais qualificados por meio de prospecção ativa, networking com a indústria e desenvolvimento de relacionamentos
  • Converter leads em oportunidades de vendas e gerenciar todo o processo de vendas, desde o contato inicial até o fechamento do contrato.
  • Expandir a presença da Empresa em contas-chave, garantindo engajamento contínuo e satisfação.


Inteligência de Mercado e Análise da Concorrência

  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, projetos de construção naval, expansões de frota e atividades de docagem em toda a região.
  • Analisar o posicionamento, os preços e as ofertas de serviços dos concorrentes para identificar oportunidades de diferenciação.
  • Compartilhar insights de mercado e feedback de clientes com equipes internas e parceiros fornecedores para orientar decisões estratégicas. Estratégia e Relatórios de Vendas
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a execução de estratégias de vendas alinhadas aos objetivos da Empresa nos setores marítimo e offshore.
  • Manter registros precisos de oportunidades, interações com clientes e status do pipeline no sistema CRM.
  • Fornecer relatórios regulares sobre atividades de vendas, previsões e desenvolvimentos de mercado.



Requisitos de Experiência

  • Experiência em vendas técnicas ou industriais B2B, preferencialmente nos setores marítimo, de construção naval ou offshore.
  • Experiência em gestão de relacionamento com estaleiros, armadores ou fornecedores de equipamentos marítimos.
  • Familiaridade com processos de compras e especificações técnicas para projetos marítimos e offshore.
  • Formação em engenharia mecânica, elétrica ou naval é uma vantagem.

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks. In this role, you will develop end-to-end ETL/ELT workflows using Databricks, PySpark and SQL, implement data quality and monitoring frameworks, and apply modern data architecture patterns (Delta Lake / Lakehouse / medallion).


You will collaborate closely with product owners and analytics teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Experience with Azure services (ADLS, ADF, Azure SQL, Key Vault), Git-based development workflows, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible) is highly valued.


Fluent English and native Portuguese are required.

  • Atuar na governança AWS multi-account: IAM com least privilege, segurança de redes e controle de acesso

  • Terraform no dia a dia — criação de módulos do zero, não só aplicação

title: Advogado - Privacidade de Dados
description:
Estamos buscando um Advogado com foco em Privacidade de Dados que será responsável por garantir a conformidade da organização com a LGPD e demais normas aplicáveis por meio da orientação jurídica especializada, revisão contratual, desenvolvimento de políticas internas e apoio direto às áreas de negócio. Atuar como agente-chave de governança em privacidade e proteção de dados, promovendo a implementação, manutenção e evolução do sistema de gestão de privacidade, monitorando mudanças regulatórias e fortalecendo a cultura de proteção de dados por meio de treinamentos, consultoria e interação contínua com o DPO e áreas técnicas.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Suportar as áreas de negócio com a revisão e negociação de Contratos em relação à LGPD;
  • Prestar consultoria jurídica interna sobre LGPD, ANPD e ANEEL no contexto de dados pessoais;
  • Elaborar e revisar políticas, procedimentos e normativos internos relacionados à privacidade e proteção de dados;
  • Apoiar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais, bem como dos Programas de Adequação à LGPD das Sociedades do Grupo;
  • Monitorar alterações regulatórias e avaliar impactos legais no tratamento de dados pessoais e nas atividades das Sociedades do Grupo;
  • Atuar junto ao DPO e áreas técnicas para garantir conformidade com a LGPD;
  • Apoiar e promover treinamentos e ações de conscientização o sobre proteção de dados (Legislação, boas práticas e normas internas).


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Direito com registro ativo na OAB;
  • Atuação ativa na aplicação e condução de processos da LGPD e demais regulamentos da ANPD;
  • Familiaridade com sistema de gestão de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais;
  • Capacidade de interpretar e aplicar normas técnicas e jurídicas em contextos multidisciplinares.


Desejáveis:


  • Certificações em LGPD, compliance, governança de dados ou segurança da informação são altamente desejáveis.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas reguladas, preferencialmente do setor elétrico.
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Direito Digital ou Proteção de Dados;

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: Analista Ongoing Pleno - CyberArk - Desenvolvedor
description:
Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um profissional júnior que poderá atuar na implementação, configuração ou suporte de soluções completas de Identity and Access Management (IAM), abrangendo todo o ecossistema de segurança de identidades:


  • IGA (Identity Governance & Administration), PAM (Privileged Access Management),
  • CIAM (Customer Identity & Access Management),
  • MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication), entre outras.


O profissional terá contato com as principais plataformas líderes de mercado, trabalhando com parceiros estratégicos globais como SailPoint, Ping Identity, CyberArk, IBM, HashiCorp, IAMOnes, Styra, iProov, Silverfort, HYPR, Cerby, Radiant Logic, StrongKey, e Customer Futures, participando de projetos de implementação em todo o ciclo de vida das soluções.


Importante:  Para essa oportunidade, buscamos um profissional que já tenha atuado com projetos de implementação de CyberArk.


Descrição

  • Participar de implantações dos sistemas de IAM, abrangendo todo o ciclo (Requisitos, Desenvolvimento/Configurações, Testes, Homologações e Suporte).
  • Customizar integrações entre os sistemas (APIs, Json, XMLs, SWAGGER, Etc).
  • Desenvolver scripts (Java, Phyton, Etc) para customizações das soluções.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica atualizada (blueprints, procedimentos operacionais)
  • Apoiar em atualizações e upgrades das ferramentas
  • Monitorar status e progresso da resolução de chamados.
  • Garantir atendimento dentro do SLA contratado.
  • Escalar incidentes de alto impacto para os níveis apropriados.
  • Manter clientes informados sobre o status e progresso dos atendimentos.
  • Buscar constantemente novas tecnologias e metodologias de melhoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • SOs: Conhecimentos básicos em microinformática tais como Linux e Windows Server, redes, segurança;
  • Java: compreender, desenvolver e ajustar códigos na linguagem Java;
  • Linux: compreender e conhecer comandos básicos para servidores Linux;
  • LDAP: conhecimento de protocolos LDAP;
  • JDBC: conhecimentos em banco de dados SQLServer;
  • DevOps: conhecimento em ferramentas de DevOps e Observability (Exs:Terraform, Ansible, DataDog, Grafana).

Diferenciais:

  • Estar cursando ou concluído algum curso de nível superior (bacharel/tecnólogo) na área de Tecnologia;
  • Ter conhecimentos básicos em gestão de identidade;
  • Inglês intermediário;

  • Conhecimento e Habilidades com ferramentas e conceitos de IA.

Perfil desejado

  • Tratar as pessoas com ética e sinceridade, buscando uma parceria no longo prazo.
  • Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias, métodos e inovações.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
