title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.
ALOCAÇÃO: Somos associados ao grupo Nord Investimentos garantindo que as melhores estratégias de alocação estarão à disposição dos seus clientes, ou seja, você terá relatórios e calls de investimento independentes e de alta qualidade.
INDEPENDÊNCIA: Trabalhamos com todos os bancos no Brasil e temos integração com 3 instituições americanas (Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers e Avenue), ou seja, onde quer que seu cliente esteja, você poderá atendê-lo.
EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.
Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.
Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.
We need tutors who can start immediately!
Characteristics
Payment in dollars.
Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.
Schedule: Flexible, free choice
Start: Immediate
Duration: Indefinite

Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
Computer with an Internet connection.
No criminal record.

title: Especialista de suprimentos
description:
Descrição da Empresa Harsco Environmental é líder global em serviços ambientais e soluções inovadoras para a indústria do aço, com mais de 130 operações ao redor do mundo. Estamos comprometidos em evoluir continuamente para atender tanto às necessidades de nossos clientes quanto dos nossos colaboradores. Priorizamos ambientes de trabalho seguros e sustentáveis, promovendo altos padrões de qualidade. Onde outros enxergam resíduos, vemos valor inexplorado e oportunidades para um futuro sustentável. Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Especialista em Compras para atuar em nossa unidade localizada no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este cargo envolve atividades como emissão e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras, análise e avaliação de fornecedores, negociações contratuais e monitoramento de processos de aquisição. O papel exige atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica para garantir a eficiência dos processos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e com necessidade de trabalho presencial. Qualificações Gestão de Pedidos: Experiência em elaboração e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras. Avaliação de Fornecedores e Negociação: Conhecimento em avaliação de fornecedores e negociações contratuais para alinhar custo-benefício e qualidade. Procurement e Análise: Habilidade na gestão de processos de compras e aplicação de habilidades analíticas para tomadas de decisão. Conhecimento de sistemas ERP e proficiência em inglês serão considerados um plus.
Desenvolvimento e homologação de novos fornecedores.
Gestão de contratos nacionais e corporativos (elaboração de minutas, definição de cláusulas, condução de processos de negociação/bid, acompanhamento mensal de prazos, fórmula paramétrica, SLA, renovações e rescisões).
Emissão de BPA (Blanket Purchase Agreement).
Emissão de CPA (Contract Purchase Agreement).
Condução de compras de CAPEX estratégicos.
Apoio na criação, análise e desenvolvimento de KPI’s.
Gestão e controle de documentação.
Acompanhamento de incidentes relacionados a pagamentos, aplicação de penalidades e apuração de responsabilidades.
Realização de análises de inteligência de mercado (redução de custos, inovação de produtos e serviços).
Relacionamento e negociação com fornecedores, clientes internos e externos.
Preparar, orientar e treinar a equipe de compras.
Cumprimento de metas de custo, produtividade, precisão e pontualidade.
Manutenção de métricas e análise de dados para avaliação de desempenho e implementação de melhorias.
Elaboração e análise de relatórios.
Atendimento às leis, regulamentos, normas de compliance, requisitos de qualidade e EHS.
Experiência de pelo menos 5 anos em áreas relacionadas à cadeia de suprimentos
Formação em Administração, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
Inglês Fluente

Gerenciar o ciclo completo de Strategic Sourcing / Procurement para diferentes categorias de compras; Estruturar e liderar processos de concorrência (RFQs, RFPs e tenders); Desenvolver, em parceria com Jurídico e Operações, os requisitos para compras, MSAs e MPAs; Definir e gerenciar o funil de Strategic Sourcing; Liderar projetos de Melhoria Contínua; Construir Value Stream Maps e coordenar iniciativas de Kaizen; Transformar a área de Procurement de um modelo transacional para tático e, posteriormente, estratégico; Atuar de forma colaborativa com as áreas de logística, manutenção e operações para previsão de demanda e otimização de estoques; Apoiar a implementação de módulos de compras em sistemas como Totvs e Salesforce; Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de Procurement, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos da área. title: Operations director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director
Introduction:
Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.
This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.
Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Permitting
Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.
Development Support
Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.
Procurement
Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.
Transaction Support
Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.
Qualifications:
University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
Willing to be responsive and communicative.
Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
Good attitude necessary.

title: Líder de logística e planejamento de demanda
description:
A So Energy é um fornecedor global de Energy as a Service , garantindo soluções personalizadas para uma ampla gama de organizações e indústrias em todo o mundo.
Estamos com uma oportunidade para: Líder de Logística e Planejamento de Demanda – Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
Breve resumo da posição:
Esta posição tem papel estratégico na liderança das operações logísticas e do planejamento de demanda, sendo responsável por transformar a área de logística de um modelo transacional para um modelo estratégico. Atuará na definição e implementação da estratégia logística, otimização de fluxos inbound e outbound, gestão de fornecedores críticos e integração com áreas-chave do negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, competitividade de custos e suporte ao crescimento da empresa.
O que buscamos (requisitos necessários)?
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
Vivência sólida em logística em empresas multinacionais;
Atuação prévia em posição de liderança na área de logística;
Forte conhecimento em logística inbound e outbound, comércio exterior e fluxos industriais de produção;
Experiência com sistemas ERP, como SAP e/ou Totvs;
Vivência tanto no lado cliente quanto fornecedor em operações logísticas (ex.: portos, freight forwarders – exceto despachante aduaneiro);
Inglês em nível avançado.
Quais serão suas responsabilidades?
Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de logística e supervisionar as atividades de todas as equipes logísticas.
Construir operações de transporte confiáveis e competitivas em custos.
Gerenciar contratos e entregáveis de Freight Forwarders, Despachantes Aduaneiros e demais fornecedores da cadeia de transporte.
Definir e implementar a estratégia e os KPIs para mobilização e desmobilização de equipamentos.
Desenhar e implementar as tecnologias e os sistemas de informação logística da empresa, visando aumentar eficiência, rentabilidade, crescimento e nível de serviço ao cliente.
Identificar e solucionar ineficiências de rotas.
Implementar o processo de planejamento de demanda para atender às previsões de vendas.
Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque.
Assegurar conformidade com as regulamentações de transporte e comércio internacional.
Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.
Colaborar com as equipes de compras, manutenção e operações para previsão de demanda e otimização de estoques.
Local de trabalho: Local: Centro - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Técnico de serviços em maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.
A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Estamos buscando um Coordenador de Operação & Manutenção (O& M) com vivência sólida em usinas termoelétricas com motores a combustão, capaz de atuar desde a fase de implantação/construção, apoiando engenharia e obra com a visão de operação, até a entrada em operação comercial e a rotina de O& M.

Sobre a Função

Posição estratégica: o profissional será o ponto de integração entre engenharia, comissionamento, fornecedores / contratistas e operação, garantindo que a planta seja entregue com confiabilidade, desempenho, segurança e conformidade técnica / documental.

Responsabilidades

Representar a operação durante a fase de implantação: antecipar riscos operacionais e garantir “operabilidade” do projeto.
Planejar e coordenar o comissionamento, testes e partida (sistemas elétricos, mecânicos, utilidades, automação / SCADA e integração).
Supervisionar testes de desempenho e validações pré-operação, assegurando aderência a requisitos técnicos e normativos.
Coordenar interface com fornecedores e empreiteiras, acompanhando cronograma, qualidade e marcos de entrega.
Consolidar e cobrar documentação técnica (procedimentos, as-built, manuais, planos de manutenção, listas de sobressalentes).
Apoiar a estruturação da operação: rotinas, indicadores, planos de manutenção, gestão de falhas e confiabilidade.
Qualificações
Formação em Engenharia Elétrica (ou correlatas).
Habilidades Necessárias

Experiência comprovada em O& M e comissionamento em geração de energia em termelétrica.
Forte capacidade de coordenação técnica, liderança e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
Perfil “mão na massa”, com presença em campo e foco em entrega.
Habilidades Preferenciais

Experiência em implantação / greenfield, comissionamento e start-up de usinas.
Especialização / MBA em Gestão de Projetos.
Inglês técnico / avançado.
Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Compensação

Remuneração compatível com o mercado + benefícios (a definir conforme modelo de contratação).

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

Projeto relevante, com alto nível de responsabilidade e visibilidade. Ambiente dinâmico, com espaço real para construir processos e formar time.

title: Consultor(a) de educação internacional sr - stb
description:
O STB é líder no segmento de educação internacional no Brasil, com mais de 50 cidades atendidas, dois escritórios na Austrália e referência nacional em atendimento online. Desde 1971, conectamos estudantes e profissionais ao mundo por meio de programas de intercâmbio educacional e trabalho no exterior.
Somos parte do ecossistema Be Fly , um dos maiores hubs de turismo e experiências da América Latina, que integra marcas inovadoras com foco em tecnologia, eficiência operacional e excelência em serviço.
Sobre a vaga
A posição de Consultor(a) de Educação Internacional Sr é fundamental para impulsionar os resultados comerciais do STB – Be Fly .
Essa pessoa será responsável por realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes interessados em programas de intercâmbio, mapear perfil, objetivos e orçamento para indicar as melhores opções de destino e curso, conduzir apresentações de escolas e universidades no exterior e atuar em negociações de maior complexidade. Também apoiará o gestor no acompanhamento de metas, garantindo a gestão do funil de vendas no sistema e participando de eventos e ações de divulgação da loja.
Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga
Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes interessados em programas de intercâmbio.
Mapear perfil, objetivos e orçamento do cliente para indicar a melhor opção de programa e destino.
Conduzir apresentações detalhadas de cursos, escolas, universidades e processos de aplicação.
Atuar em negociações de maior complexidade, assegurando o equilíbrio entre satisfação do cliente e políticas comerciais da empresa.
Apoiar o gestor da loja no acompanhamento das metas e resultados.
Acompanhar todo o funil de vendas no sistema interno, garantindo atualização das informações e controle do pipeline.
Participar de eventos, feiras e ações de divulgação da loja.
Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:
Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas em intercâmbio;
Histórico sólido de atingimento de metas e resultados comerciais;
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
Organização, visão analítica e habilidade de negociação;
Inglês avançado.
Diferenciais
Vivência internacional (como intercambista ou acadêmica).
Conhecimento em processos de aplicação para escolas no exterior.
Conhecimento em Higher Education e outros tipos de programas complexos.
Quais os benefícios de ser Be Flyer?
VR Ifood benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela Be Fly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
Assistência odontológica | Odonto Prev.
Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
Be Flyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.
E muito mais!
Se você busca desenvolvimento na Consultor(a) de Educação Internacional, quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e contribuir para uma empresa que conecta pessoas ao mundo, essa oportunidade pode ser o seu próximo passo.
Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do STB!

title: Ugc content creator
description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community 
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app 
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating 
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Gerente de projeto de design
description:
Sobre a vaga
A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/Design Ops garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:
Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \" braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.
Responsabilidades
Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês). Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como Click Up, Asana, Notion ou similares Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)
Necessário
Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Click Up, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups
Remuneração e modelo
Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Assembly and after-sales support technician
description:
Job Description
Job Title:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location:Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required
Reports to:Account Manager and CTO
Contract Type:CLTAbout LG Sonic: LG Sonicis a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.
Position duties and responsibilities:
Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.Qualification and requirements:
Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.Why Join LG Sonic?At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation.
